candidates.body: Tupac’s murder has finally been solved. Former gang boss Duane “Keffe D” Davis has been found guilty of orchestrating the murder of rapper Tupac Shakur, who was killed on September 13, 1996. The 63-year-old was convicted by a Las Vegas jury of a single count of murder with a deadly weapon and could be sentenced to life in prison. : ABC News. Allegations are not findings of guilt.

candidates.headline: Why did Keffe D feel so comfortable confessing to his role in the murder of Tupac Shakur?
candidates.body: Why did Keffe D feel so comfortable confessing to his role in the murder of Tupac Shakur? ⁣ ⁣ This week, after someone was finally convicted of killing the rap icon, fans were quick to call Keffe D an idiot for admitting to crimes on camera and in his book. ⁣ ⁣ But there may have been a very good reason why he assumed he'd never get convicted and why even local police thought the crime would never get solved. Allegations are not findings of guilt.

candidates.body:
Story - Andrew Tate has been indicted for having sex with a minor, trafficking and money laundering – and allegedly recruited a 15-year-old girl for sexual exploitation, Romanian prosecutors announced Friday.

Tate, 39, was issued with the fresh charges while he and his brother Tristan Tate, 38, remain detained at the Federal Detention Center in Miami, Fla., as they fight extradition back to the UK for alleged offenses that took place between 2010 and 2017.

Tristan Tate has been charged with complicity as part of the investigation spearheaded by Romania’s Directorate for Investigating Organized Crime and Terrorism.

Andrew Tate allegedly recruited a girl, who was 15, and sexually exploited her in the UK and Romania between 2012 and December 2021, according to prosecutors.

He allowed the girl to fall in love but used coercion, emotional blackmail, as well as physical aggression to ensure compliance, it is alleged. 

Tate allegedly forced the girl to produce sexually explicit material and practice so-called video chat activities for his pleasure, prosecutors alleged.

While the alleged sexual exploitation occurred, Tristan Tate allegedly supported his brother rather than reporting the crime.

Tristan Tate managed the girl’s video chat accounts and monitored her activity, prosecutors said.

He also “resorted to acts of physical aggression [against the girl],” prosecutors said.

candidates.body: Story - Story - The jury has reached a verdict in the first case to be tried in the case involving Dallas rapper MO3’s murder in 2020, when Melvin Noble was killed in an ambush shooting on Interstate 35E. The first man to be tried was Kewon White, who allegedly was hired by Markies Conway to murder Noble. Conway is another rapper, known as Yella Beezy, who allegedly was embroiled in a feud with MO3. On Friday, Sept. 4, jurors handed down a guilty verdict of capital murder. The judge sentenced White to life in prison without parole. Prosecutors say White ambushed the Dallas rapper for a promised payment. The defense says the state proved a murder — but not murder-for-hire. Jurors were shown video of the ambush that showed MO3 jumping out of the gold Honda he was driving before a masked suspect chased him down the freeway with a gun.

candidates.headline: Dallas Rapper MO3 Murder Case Verdict: Kewon White Guilty of Capital Murder
candidates.body: Jurors have reached a verdict in the first case to be tried in the murder of Dallas rapper MO3 in 2020. Kewon White, allegedly hired by Yella Beezy (Markies Conway) to kill MO3, was found guilty of capital murder. The judge sentenced White to life in prison without parole. Prosecutors claim White ambushed MO3 for a promised payment, while the defense argues the state proved murder but not murder-for-hire. Jurors viewed video showing MO3 jumping from his gold Honda before being chased by a masked suspect on Interstate 35E.
